thought.text: All services are up. Now set up the app in the devcontainer — create database.yml and run `bin/setup --skip-server`:

reasoning_content:
All services are up and running. Next, inside the devcontainer I need to do the following:
1. Create config/database.yml from the sample (bin/setup does this)
2. Copy the pnpm-store volume (the node_modules volume mount — the repo at /workspaces/workspace is a bind mount, and the node_modules volume from compose is mounted to /workspaces/node_modules — this is the same issue as before, and due to the relative path, the volume was created at host /workspaces/node_modules). Since node_modules doesn't exist in the repo, this is fine.

Also regarding the DATABASE_URL environment variable: the devcontainer's compose sets DATABASE_URL=postgres://zammad:zammad@postgresql:5432. I need to make sure this is included in my own exec command too.

Run bin/setup with the correct environment variables. First, check whether config/database.yml already exists — it might be in the repo. Let me verify.

action.command: ls -la /workspace/config/database.yml 2>/dev/null; echo ---; docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc 'cd /workspaces/workspace && ls -la config/database.yml 2>/dev/null; ls -la node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "no db yml check done"'
